unit.scope: Domain model invariants, value objects, all 5 condition operators, RuleEvaluationService, AutomationEngineService (live and dry-run), AutomationRun lifecycle transitions

integration.note: Deferred - requires live DB; infrastructure repositories follow the same mapper patterns as client_portal which has integration test coverage

e2e.note: Deferred - React UI not yet covered

dependencyList.note: Already in requirements.txt; imported lazily inside handler
Already in requirements.txt; imported lazily inside handler

domain.notes: Zero Django imports. Pure Python stdlib only (dataclasses, abc, enum, datetime, uuid, typing).

application.notes: Only imports from domain layer and Python stdlib. No framework types.

infrastructure.notes: Django ORM and DRF imports confined to infrastructure/. All domain interactions go through repository interfaces. Deferred ORM imports used in tasks.py and registry.py action handlers to avoid circular imports.

presentation.notes: React pages use catalyst-ui-kit components only. API calls use fetch() with auth token. No framework-specific React UI libraries beyond the existing catalyst kit.

knownIssues.description: ActivityEvent.objects.create in _handle_create_activity_event uses positional fields that may differ from the actual ActivityEvent ORM model schema. Needs verification against client_portal.ActivityEvent model fields (project_id, organization_id, metadata vs payload).
InvoiceRecord model access in check_invoice_overdue_rules assumes a .project_id field. Should be verified or guarded with hasattr.

AutomationNewPage.tsx multi-step form submits rule creation then conditions/actions as separate POST requests. If condition/action POSTs fail after the rule is created, the rule is left in a partial state. A bulk-create endpoint would prevent this.
Integration tests for DjangoAutomationRuleRepository, DjangoAutomationRunRepository are not yet written.
